notes.title: DEMO Feedback Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/acc0fc1d16aa28d965b213e1d8706a64f26650b3.png[/img]

[h1]Thanks for the Feedback.
[/h1]
Again, we just want to say a massive thank you to all of you who played the demo and submitted some feedback.

Its so awesome to hear what you guys love about the game and equally important to get your opinions on how things can be done better.

The 3 winners have been drawn and emailed their free Steam key!

If you still have some feedback to give, we are still collecting. Just submit it on the same form!
[url=https://forms.gle/ZpbMg6DY77DqhmJ88]https://forms.gle/ZpbMg6DY77DqhmJ88[/url]

[h1]Feedback Recap
[/h1]
Overall, you guys scored the demo 4/5!
We are stoked with that!

We got some honest feedback which is what its all about:
[b][list]
[*] unable to heal sometimes
[*] difficult to see how much hardware you have to spend
[*] deflecting seemed easier with the dagger than the katana
[/list][/b]
Stuff like this helps us pick up on any floating bugs and also improve the experience for you guys.

And we also got some great suggestions:
[b][list]
[*] insane mode/unlimited ammo
[*] auto aim weapons
[*] mini-bosses every few rounds
[/list][/b]
You'll be excited to know that some of these are already developed and will feature in the main release!

Come aboard, Pilot!

notes.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT + Minor DEMO Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/8e5d8dfb9e3f45eb4056d80346cc89afc11bc2ab.png[/img]

A bit of an update for our fellow Pilots!

[h2]ACHIEVEMENT BUG:[/h2]

We were made aware of a bug in our demo achievement: [b]BIG BALLER[/b]
This meant what was intended to be a difficult achievement to achieve became far too easy!

So, we made a fix. We renamed the old achievement to SMALL BALLER and rightfully implemented BIG BALLER as intended: [b]Collect and [u]HOLD[/u] 7000 hardware in a single match[/b]

How many of you can unlock this one?

Achievement Hunters, where are you at? 


[h2]MINOR DEMO UPDATE:[/h2]

Some small improvements were made to the leaderboard:
- allows for visibility of longer names
- visibility of the top 100 on the global leaderboard

[b]Where do you rank in the top 100? [/b]
Beware, those below you might just be coming for you!


[h2]LAST CHANCE TO WIN A KEY FOR FEEDBACK:[/h2]

A few hours left to submit feedback and be included in the draw for a FREE MAIN GAME KEY!

Valid entries close at [b]11:59 PM NZT[/b]

If you tried the demo, we would love to know how you found it.
The more feedback, the better!


Best,
The Battle Drones Team

notes.title: In-game Perks for your Drone
notes.content:
[h1]In-game Perks for your Drone (Red Rock Resistance Game Perks)[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/2677b5182590f872e9c91beb4fc8e25f80c17d86.png[/img]

In Red Rock Resistance, you can obtain perks during the game to boost your play style. Perks are special benefits that help you during battles with enemy drones.

A different icon represents every perk that you can buy and obtain specific advantages. You can purchase perks using the drone parts you collect after destroying a hostile drone.

For example, you must collect 500 drone parts to buy the [b]Meteoroids[/b] perk (which adds a 10% damage bonus).

Check out the perks below so you’re clued up before our game is released!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*o_42_hdHhj1j-7nE[/img]

[b]Types of in-game perks:[/b]

[b]Meteoroids[/b]

[u]Harness extraterrestrial energy to inflict more damage on enemies.[/u]

Perk type: Damage

Effect: All weapon damage increased by 10%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/22af54a538de96a28f935e9000c8d7ec536bc3e5.png[/img]

[b]Solomon’s Insurance[/b]

[u]If you ever feel your life is in danger Solomon can guarantee you a second chance with his very own drone insurance.[/u]

Perk Type: Revival

Effect: Instantly revives upon death with one health bar (all drone upgrades lost on death, weapon upgrades remain).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/86dbd65d37a7766fa32dfbdb103d9a835bc05726.png[/img]

[b]Bullet King (Coming Soon)[/b]

[u]The king of bullets loves some melee combat, buy this perk and ensure a return of ammunition on every melee kill[/u]

Perk Type: Ammunition Reload

Return of ammunition with each melee kill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/4260503d03205d6c91573098ba86465d0c3f8d80.png[/img]

[b]UTA Flak Jacket[/b]

[u]The UTA sure know how to make a durable drone body, buy their flak jacket and gain 10% damage resistance.[/u]

Perk Type: Resist

Adds 10% resist to all damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/76658a6884e0c83c666f59a5d868410529d13970.png[/img]

[b]Celerity Speed Cream[/b]

[u]Cutting-edge race technology patented by industry leader Celerity gives you increased drone movement speed[/u]

Perk Type: Speed

Effect: Drone Movement speed increased by 10%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/afab24416ba0dfcdaeb0e12f9787c8a968eaf851.png[/img]

What do you think about the perks? Which one is your favourite? Let us know over on our community page!

[b]Come aboard Pilot![/b]
